This role is responsible for designing, building, and deploying secure, production-ready enterprise web applications — owning full stack solutioning end-to-end, from front-end UI to back-end services, APIs, and Azure cloud hosting. The position takes prototypes and proof-of-concept web pages through to hardened, tested, enterprise-published production releases, supporting Anglo-Eastern's digital transformation by delivering secure, scalable, and business-focused solutions that improve efficiency, decision-making, and operational performance.

ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Design, build, and maintain secure, production-grade enterprise web applications covering front-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive UI) and back-end (REST APIs, services, integrations, SQL databases, and data models).

Take prototype and proof-of-concept web pages/applications through hardening, security review, performance optimisation, and testing to make them fully enterprise production-ready.

Develop, deploy, and support Azure-based hosting using Azure App Service, Static Web Apps, Container Apps, Functions, Storage, Azure SQL, and monitoring, publishing applications for enterprise-wide access with appropriate authentication (Microsoft Entra ID / SSO) and access control.

Own end-to-end solution delivery, from requirement analysis and design to development, deployment, support, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Work with business stakeholders to understand needs, recommend practical technology solutions, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards, security, and business value.

Manage code, CI/CD pipelines, deployments, release/publishing of enterprise web applications, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support across Development, UAT, and Production environments.

Requirements

KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect - Preferred
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, or a recognised full stack / web development certification - Good to have
• Python, JavaScript/Node.js, DevOps, or Security certification - Good to have

Specific Business Knowledge:

• Strong front-end development skills in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a modern UI framework (React, Angular, or Vue.js), including responsive and accessible web design
• Strong back-end development skills in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and/or Node.js, with REST API design, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices
• Proven experience taking prototype or proof-of-concept web pages/applications through to hardened, tested, production-ready releases, including code refactoring, performance tuning, and security remediation
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure for enterprise web hosting, including Azure App Service, Static Web Apps, Container Apps, Functions, Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, and Application Insights/monitoring
• Strong database skills covering SQL Server or Azure SQL, database design, query optimization, views, stored procedures, and data modelling
• Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/containerisation, environment (Dev/UAT/Prod) deployments, release management, and production support
• Good to have: Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), Power BI, Azure OpenAI/Generative AI integration, microservices architecture, API management, and Kubernetes
• Strong analytical, communication, ownership, stakeholder management, troubleshooting, prioritization, and continuous improvement skills

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience: 

5-8 years of experience in full stack web application development, covering both front-end and back-end engineering.

Experience taking web applications from prototype/proof-of-concept through to secure, production-ready, enterprise-hosted deployment on Microsoft Azure, together with software engineering best practices, cloud architecture, and enterprise security.

Benefits

About Anglo-Eastern

Anglo-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.

Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.

Why join Anglo-Eastern?

• Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years 
• Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long-term relationships 
• Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network 
• Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future 

Join us today!

Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture.  Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Corporate Systems Product Management focuses on the internal platforms that power how Smartsheet operates - including Finance, People, Sales and Entitlements, Billing and Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation. Product Managers in this team steward product strategy, roadmaps, business workflows, and long-term platform evolution across these domains, partnering closely with Engineering and business stakeholders to translate complex enterprise needs into scalable technology outcomes.

As Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems, you will lead the Product Management function across Corporate Systems, managing and developing a team of Product Managers responsible for some of Smartsheet’s most critical internal technology domains. You will establish a cohesive product strategy across the portfolio, ensuring domain roadmaps connect to company priorities while identifying dependencies and opportunities that span traditional organizational and system boundaries.

You will operate at both the strategic and execution levels: coaching Product Managers to develop strong product practices, partnering with Engineering leadership on portfolio strategy and investment decisions, and directly engaging in the most complex cross-functional initiatives. You will help evolve Corporate Systems from a collection of enterprise applications and projects into a product-led portfolio of platforms, capabilities, data, integrations, and employee experiences designed for long-term scale.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Engineering leadership and senior stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, Sales/GTM, Product Engineering, Data, Security, and other business functions.

You Will:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for Financial Systems, People Systems, Sales & Entitlements, Billing & Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation

• Define and evolve the product-management operating model for Corporate Systems, establishing consistent practices for product discovery, customer problem definition, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, metrics, and lifecycle management

• Establish a cohesive portfolio strategy that connects individual product domains to Corporate Systems and company-level objectives

• Partner with Engineering leadership to align product and technical strategy, ensuring investments balance new capabilities with platform health, reliability, scalability, security, technical debt, and operational sustainability

• Drive portfolio-level prioritization and investment decisions across competing business needs, helping teams focus capacity on the highest-value problems and outcomes

• Identify and manage dependencies across domains, particularly where business processes span Product, Sales, entitlements, billing, Finance, People systems, integrations, automation, and enterprise data

• Coach Product Managers to deeply understand their customers, business processes, systems, data flows, and technical constraints rather than operating primarily as requirements or project managers

• Raise the technical and systems fluency of the Product Management organization, enabling PMs to effectively partner with software engineers, architects, application engineers, Data teams, and Security

• Ensure product strategies and roadmaps are grounded in measurable customer and business outcomes, with clear success metrics and mechanisms for evaluating product health and value

• Create clarity across ambiguous or highly cross-functional initiatives where ownership, requirements, system boundaries, or desired outcomes are not immediately clear

• Partner with senior business leaders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into coherent technology capabilities and investment plans

• Lead product thinking for major cross-domain transformations such as new pricing and monetization models, enterprise AI adoption, ERP and billing modernization, enterprise data governance, and automation

• Establish mechanisms for portfolio planning, roadmap reviews, product health reviews, dependency management, and executive communication across Corporate Systems

• Ensure Product Managers balance stakeholder requests with longer-term product strategy, challenging solution-first requirements and identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate processes

• Champion data-informed product management, including clear product KPIs, adoption measures, operational metrics, customer feedback, and outcome measurement

• Partner with Engineering leadership to improve how Product and Engineering teams work together from discovery and design through delivery, operational readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement

• Communicate portfolio strategy, investment decisions, progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership

• Build strong relationships across Product Engineering, Finance, People & Culture, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, and other functions, influencing outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority

• Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and capability building for the Corporate Systems Product Management team

You Have:

• 10+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, Business Systems, or related experience, including significant ownership of complex enterprise or platform products

• 3+ years of experience leading, managing, or formally coaching Product Managers, with demonstrated ability to raise product-management capability and develop strong product leaders

• Experience owning or overseeing a portfolio of interconnected products, platforms, or enterprise systems rather than a single application or business process

• Strong product-management fundamentals, including customer discovery, problem definition, product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, metrics, and outcome measurement

• Strong technical and systems fluency, with the ability to reason about APIs, integrations, data flows, system boundaries, platform architecture, automation, and enterprise application ecosystems

• Experience partnering closely with Engineering leadership to shape technical strategy, evaluate tradeoffs, and translate business needs into scalable platform capabilities

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple systems, business functions, and technical teams

• Experience with enterprise platforms and business processes across areas such as Finance, Sales/GTM, HR/People, billing, monetization, data, or automation

• Ability to distinguish customer problems from requested solutions and coach teams and stakeholders toward simpler, higher-leverage outcomes

• Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to prioritization, product health, and investment decisions

PhonePe Private Limited

Job Description

About PhonePe

PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 400 million registered users. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. In 2017, PhonePe forayed into financial services with the launch of digital gold, providing users with a safe and convenient option to buy 24-karat gold securely on its platform. PhonePe has since launched Mutual Funds and Insurance products like tax-saving funds, liquid funds, international travel insurance, Corona Care, a dedicated insurance product for the COVID-19 pandemic among others.

Opportunity:

PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Product Manager at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our platform and user centric products. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

• Identify large problem statements and break it down into platform level component designs. 
• Scope and phase product building meaningfully over and above standard use cases. 
• Translate pod and product strategy into a crisp, annual roadmap and define measurable objectives of a suite of products
• Be the subject matter expert in driving business decisions and fuly understand cost and revenue implications of your product suite. 
• Drive annual and quarterly planning and execution cadences across pods. 
• Be the thought leader for the product suite and evangelize goals and objectives. Drive alignment across stakeholders by effectively engaging them with data. 
• Participate in interviews for PM, APM roles and provide inputs for resource planning across functions. 

What we look for:

• Excellent communication skills. 
• Atleast 5+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development
• Analytical and data driven with the ability to to derive action and make decisions based on large data sets. 
• Good with scalable data modeling and abstractions on platform design. Can think over and above traditional use cases. 
• Come with a strong point of view on all aspects of the business and balance between a data backed view and ambiguity. 
• Is able to own output metrics and impact while balancing priorities across pods. 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

5f70b51a83407366.description: ## **About Bureau** Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally. Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond. ## **Why Bureau?** Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading. **What You'll Do** - Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform data from device SDKs, internal services, partner APIs, and third-party data providers - Write and own backend services and RESTful APIs that serve data to internal teams and to real-time decisioning paths - Develop Airflow DAGs powering reporting, compliance analytics, model training, and feature pipelines, and keep them healthy day to day - Write Spark jobs and SQL transformations against our data lake, and tune them when they get slow or expensive - Add monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to the pipelines you own so problems surface before a stakeholder notices - Debug production issues across the stack: a Kafka consumer lagging, a schema change breaking downstream, a query that got 10x slower after a data volume jump - Work with the infrastructure your pipelines and services run on — containers, deployments, cluster configs — and help keep it stable and cost-sane - Contribute to our identity graph work, helping model relationships between entities to surface fraud rings and hidden linkages - Write documentation and tests, participate in design reviews, and help keep our schemas and contracts sane as the system grows **What You'll Bring** **Must have** - 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to data-intensive systems - Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala, and the ability to write production-quality, tested code - Strong SQL: joins, window functions, aggregations, and enough of a mental model of query execution to know why something is slow - Working understanding of databases, including the difference between OLTP and OLAP systems and when each is appropriate - Hands-on experience with at least one distributed data processing framework (Spark preferred) or a genuine willingness to ramp up quickly - Experience building or maintaining backend services and REST APIs - Familiarity with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred) and core services like S3, EC2, and managed databases - Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, and the basics of distributed systems - Comfort with Git, code review, and CI/CD **Nice to have** - Infrastructure and systems knowledge — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or similar IaC, and a working sense of how services get deployed, scaled, and monitored in production - Experience running or tuning distributed workloads: cluster sizing, resource tuning, or tracking down a bottleneck between compute and storage - Exposure to Kafka or MSK, or any streaming/event-driven system - Experience with Airflow or a similar orchestration tool - Exposure to EMR, Athena, ClickHouse, Databricks, or Snowflake - Awareness of lakehouse table formats such as Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi - Familiarity with observability tooling — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent - Any experience with graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune) - Interest in or exposure to fraud, risk, identity, fintech, or other high-stakes real-time domains - Exposure to ML workflows: feature pipelines, training data preparation, or model serving **What We Look For** - You debug rather than guess, and you can explain what actually went wrong - You ask what the data is for before deciding how to model it - You're curious about the layer below the one you work in — how your code actually runs, where it fails, what it costs - You're comfortable being new to a tool and getting productive in it quickly - You care that numbers are right, because at Bureau a wrong number is a wrong risk decision ## **Our Culture** - We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way - We value performance, not hours worked - Speed, ownership, and impact matter most ## **Compensation** - Competitive salary + potential equity - Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

5f045c2f2e2877e6.description: ### **About the Role** We're building the future of education and are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. We run a consumer app that delivers short-form videos and bite-sized revision content for exam preparation — built for aspirants who study on a phone, in short bursts, largely across Tier 2/3 India. You won't just be pulling reports; you'll be the person who answers "what is actually happening in our app, and what should we do about it?" Ideally, you are someone who can take a vague question, turn it into a measurable one, and come back with an answer the team can act on the same week. ### **What You'll Do** - **Instrumentation & Data Quality:** Audit our Mixpanel event taxonomy — what's tracked, what's broken, what's double-counted, what's missing. Work with engineers to fix the tracking plan. - **Funnel Ownership:** Own the activation funnel end to end — install → first app open → login/signup → first content view → first completed video → habit. Break each step down by source, device, geo, cohort and exam category. Find the drops, size them in users and in rupees, and tell us where to fix first. - **Notifications & Lifecycle:** Own notification opt-in, delivery, open rate and downstream session quality — by segment, by time of day, by message type. Tell us who to send what and when, then prove it with a test rather than a hunch. - **ETL & Data Plumbing:** Pull raw event data out of Mixpanel, join it with backend/Postgres data, campaign data and content metadata. Build clean, reusable datasets so recurring questions take minutes, not days. - **Feature Measurement:** For everything we ship — define the success metric and the guardrail metric before launch, read the result honestly after, including when it's flat or negative. Recommend what to double down on and what to kill. - **Retention & Content Analytics:** D1/D7/D30 retention curves, cohort behaviour, session depth, completion rate per video, and which formats, topics and lengths actually bring users back. - **End-to-End Ownership:** Close the loop with a short weekly written view — what moved, why, what we do next week. Two pages, no fluff. An insight nobody reads is worth zero. ### **Metrics You'll Live Inside** - First app open - Login / signup conversion - Notification opt-in, delivery, CTR - Activation rate · D1 / D7 / D30 retention · DAU / WAU / MAU and stickiness - Session length and sessions per user · Content completion rate - Funnel drop-off by step - CAC and channel quality ### **What You Bring** - **Real Consumer Exposure:** Hands-on work with a consumer/D2C mobile app's numbers — via an internship, a startup, a growth team or a serious side project. You've seen real user data at real volume, not a Kaggle CSV. - **Product Analytics:** Working knowledge of **Mixpanel** (strongly preferred), or Amplitude, CleverTap, MoEngage, Firebase or GA4. - **SQL:** Joins, CTEs, window functions, cohort and funnel queries against **PostgreSQL**. - **Tooling:** Excel/Google Sheets at a serious level, and **Python (pandas)** for anything Sheets can't handle. - **Metric Judgement:** You understand what a number *means*, not just how to compute it. You can explain why D1 retention and notification opt-in move together, what rising DAU with falling session length is telling you, and when a metric went up for a reason that isn't good news. - **Communication:** You write clearly and argue from evidence. You're comfortable telling a founder their favourite feature isn't working. ### **Nice to Have** - Previous experience in a high-growth, product-based startup and have seen their journey. - Ability to incorporate AI tools into daily analytics workflows to drive efficiency and deliver higher quality outcomes. - Edtech, content, short-video or subscription consumer experience. - A/B testing — designing a test, sizing it, calling it, and knowing when a result isn't significant. - Exposure to Segment, CleverTap, MoEngage, AppsFlyer or Branch attribution. - Understanding of Bharat / Tier 2-3 user behaviour, Hindi-first audiences, low-end Android and patchy connectivity. ### **Culture Fit** - **Adaptive to Ambiguity:** You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where requirements may shift. You can move forward without having every single detail defined upfront. - **Problem Solver:** You view messy data and unexplained drops as puzzles to be solved. - **AI Evangelist:** You are someone who moves faster with AI — spending enough time framing the problem and then letting the models do their magic, with proper guardrails (sanity checks and validation so we move fast without shipping wrong numbers). ### **What You Get** - Direct access to the founders. Your analysis reaches the people who decide, the same day. - Full ownership of analytics — you're not the fourth analyst in a ticket queue. - Visibility across the whole loop: acquisition, product, content and retention, in one place. - Certificate, letter of recommendation, and a PPO for strong performers.

About Us 
Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.  
Today, 20 million+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.   
We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.  
Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
And this is just the beginning!
 
What’s the role?  
As an Associate Product Manager at Nek by Jar, you will own the platform and internal systems that power Nek’s day-to-day operations. This includes our internal Order Management / CRM tools and key third-party integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other operational partners.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, and external partners to improve these systems, resolve gaps, and support new product initiatives. You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Nek’s overall architecture, services, integrations, and data flows so that you can evaluate the impact of new features across the platform.
 
What will be your responsibilities?
 
• Platform & Internal Tools
• Own Nek’s internal Order Management / CRM platform and other operational tools used by Customer Support and Operations teams.
• Identify product and process gaps and drive improvements that make internal systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.
• Understand the end-to-end order lifecycle across inventory, payments, logistics, communication, and post-order journeys.
• Integrations & Architecture
• Act as the Product POC for integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other logistics or operational partners.
• Own integration requirements, feature enablement, partner coordination, and issue resolution.
• Develop a working understanding of APIs, services, dependencies, data flows, failure scenarios, and reconciliation across the platform.
• Evaluate and onboard new third-party platforms as business requirements evolve. 
• Data & Experimentation
• Use product and operational data to identify problems, validate hypotheses, and prioritise opportunities.
• Analyse funnels, user behaviour, operational metrics, and feature performance using tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, SQL, and dashboards.
• Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, define success metrics, and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated, or stopped. 
• Execution
• Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, Design, and Business teams to take initiatives from problem identification to launch.
• Translate business and operational problems into clear product requirements and scalable solutions.
• Monitor outcomes after launch and drive subsequent improvements. 
What’s required from you?
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline from a reputed institute.
• 1–3 years of experience in Product, Growth, Product Analytics, or a similar role in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
• Strong analytical skills and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clevertap, SQL, or similar platforms.
• Good understanding of A/B testing, funnels, metrics, and data-driven product decision-making.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to prioritise effectively and work across multiple teams in a fast-paced environment.
• Prior experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, or order/logistics-heavy products is preferred. 
What do we stand for? 
 
The five values that we live by : 
Passion: At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work. 
Equality: We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves. 
Growth: When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact. 
Accountability: The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions. 
Consistency: We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time. 
Join us and let’s build something amazing together!   

What employee benefits do we have? 
Glad you asked! Among other things, we have 
• Medical Insurance for employees and their families
• Employee Wellbeing Program
• ESOPs allocation
• Pluxee meal card
• Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts 
• Advance salary plans
• Relocation assistance
• L&D programmes
